name: calliday
title: Calliday
description: Automatic time tracking, at your fingertips. See what Calliday is tracking right now, browse today's report, search the documents and pages you've spent time in, grow pomodoro tomatoes, and start timers - all read from the local database on your Mac; nothing touches the network.
author: yaanisy

commands.name: now
commands.title: Current Activity
commands.description: What Calliday is tracking right now, with today's total.

commands.name: today
commands.title: Today's Report
commands.description: Today by project, app, and site.

commands.name: tomatoes
commands.title: Tomatoes
commands.description: Today's harvest, run by run — and the one on the vine.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Activity
commands.description: Find a document or page in your tracked activity, then jump to it on the timeline or open it.

commands.name: start-tomato
commands.title: Start a Tomato
